color: rgb(21, 57, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Windows first. The window is a viewer. harnessd owns the build
A utility process would die with the Electron shell, so the daemon
is detached and runs the Electron binary as plain Node
A named pipe for the current user, plus a session token:
no localhost port, so a web page cannot reach it
Not a Windows Service: Git config, the vault and plan logins
belong to the user. One daemon per Windows user

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Window: chat, canvas, cockpit, office. A crash reopens and reconnects
Electron main: tray, notifications, updates. The daemon keeps running
harnessd: coordinator per project, state.db, global broker,
adapters, MCP, sandbox launcher, MinGit, verifier, doc fetcher
Workers and verifiers: one attempt each. A crash returns to the checkpoint

div.style: color: rgb(64, 48, 11) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: Close the window?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: The app quits. The daemon stops after a short grace period

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Hide to the tray. First time: still building, N workers
Tray: Open, Pause all, status, Quit

div.style: color: rgb(64, 48, 11) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: Quit while building?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Checkpoint everything, about 10 seconds, then quit

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Sleep: pause dispatch, reconcile on wake. In-flight calls are unknown
Shutdown or sign-out: checkpoint inside the shutdown window
Anything missed resumes from the previous turn boundary
Prevent sleep while building is off by default
Start at sign-in is optional, for resumes after a plan window resets
A second launch focuses the existing window

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Installer, about 200 MB: Electron, daemon, UI, MinGit,
gitleaks, tree-sitter grammars, office art
On demand, size shown, SHA-256 from a signed manifest:
Whisper at first mic use. Playwright browsers at first browser tests
Node, pnpm or Python if the project needs them and they are missing
Ollama, LM Studio, Docker and WSL2 are never bundled
A bad checksum is refused. Downloads resume. Any component can be removed

div.style: color: rgb(64, 48, 11) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: What is updating?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Signed differential download in the background
Restart to update only after every task is parked
A live build says: applies after this build, or when you choose

div.style: color: rgb(21, 57, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
user_version on each SQLite file
1 Park work, exclusive lock, VACUUM INTO a backup
2 Forward-only migrations. Additive directly; constraint changes
use SQLite's 12-step rebuild, then search indexes rebuild
3 quick_check and invariants. On failure, restore the backup
global.db first. Each project migrates on open; a failure marks
only that project needs repair. Hourly and daily backups too
Corruption: salvage, or restore, then replay harness-state and Git
An older app cannot open a newer database. It offers the backup

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Resume with the prompt and skill versions the task started with
New versions apply to the next attempt
Old checkpoint formats are upcast on read, never rewritten in place

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Signed JSON, checked daily. New dispatches use the new file
Only a revoked route parks running work, at the next boundary

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Its own installer. A new version runs the conformance suite
before that runtime gets new tasks

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Electron, React, TypeScript, React Flow, ELK, PixiJS
Daemon on the bundled Node. SQLite via node:sqlite, FTS5,
better-sqlite3 only as fallback. Git is MinGit, not a library
ACP, MCP and vendor SDKs. Playwright. NSIS via electron-builder, signed
Electron and Node versions move together, checked in CI

div.style: color: rgb(21, 57, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Logs, traces and crash dumps stay on this PC. Nothing is sent
JSON logs for 14 days, secrets redacted before they are written
A span per transaction, attempt, model call, tool, Git op and verification
Health page: queues, rate limits, latency, verifier time, sandbox denials
Help, Export diagnostics: a redacted bundle, previewed before it is saved

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Two Windows users: separate daemon, pipe, data and sandbox identities
Daemon still on the old version: park, exit, start the new one
Disk: warn at 15 GB, no new dispatch at 5 GB, Pause all at 2 GB
Antivirus quarantine: name the file, re-download and verify
Moving the data folder: park, move, repair worktree paths
